criterion: An approved rollback rehearsal must succeed on the target release and production configuration.
explanation: The acceptance criterion requires verified success of the rollback rehearsal on R2.4/production/p7. While REC-6011 (KAN-108) confirms success for RB-401, REC-6198 (KAN-177) explicitly documents a failure for RB-402 with data loss in production. Since the requirement is linked to both records and a FAIL in any linked dependency blocks the release, the overall decision is FAIL. Developer status updates without QA verification details are insufficient.

evidence.excerpt: Rollback rehearsal RB-402: release R2.4; commit b7a91f2; service atlas-assistant; environment production. Restore completed but 214 session records written during the window were lost. Rehearsal FAILED.
evidence.why: Comment #2 (10860) from Arjun Mehta (QA Lead) explicitly states rollback rehearsal RB-402 failed with data loss in production environment for R2.4/b7a91f2
Comment #5 (10528) from Sam Patel (Developer) confirms RB-401 succeeded with no data loss in production for R2.4/b7a91f2
Developer status updates alone do not satisfy QA verification requirements
